purpose: Check that contamination robustness does not buy tail protection by materially degrading clean or near-clean worlds.

retain_rule.per_seed: CR1 maximum primary regret <= R0_T2 maximum primary regret + 0.0010 AND CR1 mean primary regret <= R0_T2 mean primary regret + 0.0010 AND clean_T2_exact regret penalty <= 0.0030
retain_rule.replication: all conditions must pass independently in both seeds
retain_rule.failure: any failure removes CR1 from broad synthetic lead status; no post-hoc threshold change
